name: TextRange2
description: Represents the text frame in a Shape or ShapeRange object.
remarks: This object contains the text in the text frame as well as the properties and methods that control the alignment and anchoring of the text frame. Use the TextFrame2 property to return a TextFrame2 object.
example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
With myDocument.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, _
 0, 0, 250, 140).TextFrame2
 .TextRange.Text = "Here is some test text"
 .MarginBottom = 10
 .MarginLeft = 10
 .MarginRight = 10
 .MarginTop = 10
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the current instance of the Microsoft Office application. When used with an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the creator of the TextRange2 object. When used with an OLE Automation object, it returns the object's application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the TextRange2 object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Gets or sets a String value that represents the text in a text range. Read/write.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the TextRange2 collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the TextRange2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Paragraphs
properties.description: Gets a TextRange2 object that represents the specified subset of text paragraphs. Read-only.

properties.name: Sentences
properties.description: Returns a TextRange2 object that represents the specified subset of text sentences. Read-only.

properties.name: Words
properties.description: Gets a TextRange2 object that represents the specified subset of text words. Read-only.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Read-only.

properties.name: Lines
properties.description: Returns a TextRange2 object that represents the specified subset of text lines. Read-only.

properties.name: Runs
properties.description: Gets a TextRange2 object that represents the specified subset of text runs. A text run consists of a range of characters that share the same font attributes. Read-only.

properties.name: ParagraphFormat
properties.description: Returns a ParagraphFormat object that represents paragraph formatting for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents character formatting for the TextRange2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Gets a Long that represents the length of a text range. Read-only.

properties.name: Start
properties.description: Gets a Long value indicating the starting point of the specified text range. Read-only.

properties.name: BoundLeft
properties.description: Gets the left coordinate, in points, of the text bounding box for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: BoundTop
properties.description: Gets the top coordinate, in points, of the text bounding box for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: BoundWidth
properties.description: Gets the width, in points, of the text bounding box for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: BoundHeight
properties.description: Gets the height, in points, of the text bounding box for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: LanguageID
properties.description: Gets or sets the MsoLanguageID value of the TextRange2 object. Read/write.

properties.name: MathZones
properties.description: Sets the starting point and length of a math zone within a text range. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Gets the range of text specified by the index number from the TextRange2 object.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the text range.

methods.name: TrimText
methods.description: Returns a TextRange2 object that represents the specified text that has the whitespace removed.

methods.name: InsertAfter
methods.description: Inserts text to the right of the existing text in the TextRange2 object.

parameters.name: NewText
parameters.description: Contains the text to be inserted.

methods.name: InsertBefore
methods.description: Inserts text to the left of the existing text in the TextRange2 object.

parameters.name: NewText
parameters.description: Contains the text to be inserted.

methods.name: InsertSymbol
methods.signature: InsertSymbol(FontName As String, CharNumber As Long, [Unicode As MsoTriState]) As TextRange2
methods.description: Inserts a symbol from the specified font set into the range of text represented by the TextRange2 object.

parameters.name: FontName
parameters.description: The name of the font set.

parameters.name: CharNumber
parameters.description: The number of the symbol.

parameters.name: Unicode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the value of the symbol is specified as a unicode value.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the TextRange2 object.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Removes a portion or all of the text from a range of text.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies a TextRange2 object.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a TextRange2 object.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Pastes the contents of the Clipboard into the TextRange2 object.

methods.name: PasteSpecial
methods.description: Replaces the text range with the contents of the Clipboard in the format specified. If the paste succeeds, this method returns a TextRange2 object, including the text range that was pasted.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Determines the format for the Clipboard contents when they're inserted into the document.

methods.name: ChangeCase
methods.description: Changes the case of a TextRange2 object to one of the values in the MsoTextChangeCase enumeration.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of change to make to the text.

methods.name: AddPeriods
methods.description: Adds period (.) punctuation to the right side of the text contained in a TextRange2 object for left-to-right languages and on the left side for right-to-left languages.

methods.name: RemovePeriods
methods.description: Removes all period (.) punctuation from the text in the TextRange2 object.

methods.name: Find
methods.signature: Find(FindWhat As String, [After As Long], [MatchCase As MsoTriState], [WholeWords As MsoTriState]) As TextRange2
methods.description: Searches a TextRange2 object for a subset of text.

parameters.name: FindWhat
parameters.description: Contains the text to find.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: Specifies the point in the text range to start the search.

parameters.name: MatchCase
parameters.description: Specifies if the target text must exactly match the case of the search text.

parameters.name: WholeWords
parameters.description: Specifies that only whole words will be searched.

methods.name: Replace
methods.signature: Replace(FindWhat As String, ReplaceWhat As String, [After As Long], [MatchCase As MsoTriState], [WholeWords As MsoTriState]) As TextRange2
methods.description: Finds specific text in a text range, replaces the found text with a specified string, and returns a TextRange2 object that represents the first occurrence of the found text. Returns Nothing if no match is found.

parameters.name: FindWhat
parameters.description: The text to search for.

parameters.name: ReplaceWhat
parameters.description: The text you want to replace the found text with.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The position of the character (in the specified text range) after which you want to search for the next occurrence of FindWhat. For example, if you want to search from the fifth character of the text range, specify 4 for After. If this argument is omitted, the first character of the text range is used as the starting point for the search.

parameters.name: MatchCase
parameters.description: Determines whether a distinction is made on the basis of case.

parameters.name: WholeWords
parameters.description: Determines whether only whole words are searched.

methods.name: RotatedBounds
methods.signature: RotatedBounds(X1 As Single, Y1 As Single, X2 As Single, Y2 As Single, X3 As Single, Y3 As Single, x4 As Single, y4 As Single)
methods.description: Gets the coordinates of the vertices of the text bounding box for the specified text range. Read-only.

parameters.name: X1
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _X_ coordinate of the first vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

parameters.name: Y1
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _Y_ coordinate of the first vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

parameters.name: X2
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _X_ coordinate of the second vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

parameters.name: Y2
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _Y_ coordinate of the second vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

parameters.name: X3
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _X_ coordinate of the third vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

parameters.name: Y3
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _Y_ coordinate of the third vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

parameters.name: x4
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _X_ coordinate of the fourth vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

parameters.name: y4
parameters.description: Returns the position (in points) of the _Y_ coordinate of the fourth vertex of the bounding box for the text within the specified text range.

methods.name: RtlRun
methods.description: Returns a TextRange2 object that represents the specified subset of right-to-left text runs. A text run consists of a range of characters that share the same font attributes.

methods.name: LtrRun
methods.description: Returns a TextRange2 object that represents the specified subset of left-to-right text runs. A text run consists of a range of characters that share the same font attributes.

methods.name: InsertChartField
methods.signature: InsertChartField(ChartFieldType As MsoChartFieldType, [Formula As String], [Position As Long]) As TextRange2
methods.description: Inserts a field into the body of a data label in a chart.

parameters.name: ChartFieldType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of chart field to insert into a data label.

parameters.name: Formula
parameters.description: Specifies a cell (or range) if the msoChartFieldFormula constant is passed in for the _ChartFieldType_ parameter.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Specifies the character position where the chart field is inserted. The default is to append the field to the end of the text. If the position value is out of range, the default is used.
